description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of epochs and the Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning methods of the Whisper model, specifically for the "small" type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents the WER, also with a linear scale, ranging from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick labels at every 2.5 units. The plot displays four lines, each representing a different fine-tuning method: "small AdaLoRA_int4" (brown, circle marker, dash-dot line style), "small AdaLoRA_int8" (brown, square marker, solid line style), "small int4" (orange, circle marker, dashed line style), and "small int8" (orange, square marker, dotted line style). The "small AdaLoRA_int4" line starts at a WER of approximately 30.0 at epoch 0 and decreases to around 25.0 at epoch 6, with a notable drop between epochs 4 and 5. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" line begins at a WER of about 30.0 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 26.0 at epoch 6. The "small int4" line starts at a WER of around 30.2 at epoch 0, increases to about 33.0 at epoch 1, and then decreases to approximately 31.0 at epoch 6. The "small int8" line begins at a WER of approximately 35.0 at epoch 0, peaks at around 42.5 at epoch 2, and then declines to about 31.0 at epoch 6.
